svg.title: A timeout that stays unknown
svg.desc: A core agent opens a task to book a courier. The ambassador journals its intent and sends the command. When no answer comes back, the outcome is unknown, the resource is held and no fallback is offered. A retry under a new key is refused until a person settles it. Ask: 1. Core agent calls Ambassador: book courier, key k-1042. 2. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: policy, admission. Journal first, then act: 3. Ambassador sends to Journal: intent, op-1042. 4. Ambassador calls Courier system: command, op-1042. If answer arrives: 5a. Courier system replies to Ambassador: confirmed. 6a. Ambassador sends to Journal: outcome, succeeded. 7a. Ambassador replies to Core agent: succeeded. If no answer: 5b. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: timeout means unknown, hold order, refused. 6b. Ambassador sends to Journal: outcome, unknown. 7b. Ambassador replies to Core agent: unknown, no fallback, refused. A retry: 8. Core agent calls Ambassador: retry, new key k-1043. 9. Ambassador replies to Core agent: rejected, resource held, refused.
